officialAA.name: Take Aim
officialAA.description: Extends the attack range of this hero's weapon.
officialAA.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Attacks also proc Assassinate on the target. 5s cooldown.

officialAA.name: Tidebringer
officialAA.description: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.

officialAA.name: Tricks of the Trade
officialAA.description: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world while striking random enemy heroes from behind in an area around him.
officialAA.differences: Has a greatly increased cast point.
officialAA.superUpgrade: Super: Increases the number of attacks by 1, hits 1 extra target per attack, and -4s CDR.
officialAA.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Casts a level 4 Smoke Screen on the ground while casting Tricks of the Trade which lasts 2s.

officialAA.name: Unleash
officialAA.description:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for 2s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for 1.5s.

Marci gains 15% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
officialAA.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Cooldown reduced by 10 seconds. While Unleash is active, casting spells creates a pulse.

officialAA.name: Windrun
officialAA.description: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks, while slowing movement of nearby enemies.

TA: The AA Gaben does not specify the Assassinate native rank. Existing maximum3 working choice is retained;native3damage700 is not falsely attributed to explicit AA rank evidence.
Released Grenade/Assassinate source death,source removal,stolen-slot expiration and replacement have not each been closed by direct skill-specific historical evidence/results.
Grenade arc height,vertical-motion interruption,tree removal and Roshan-map interactions have no complete planar equivalent;no invented damage/range compensation.
TB: Eligibility changed mid-windup and the full set of instant/ranged callers need caller-specific source proof;Dagger and true Chakra/CPA/Phantasm are finite covered examples.
Arena automatic always-on autocast and duplicate same-ID status identity are engineering input/instance policies,not certification of all native manual/autocast/Rubick combinations.
Pre7.33silence/Break behavior is version-locked by direct7.33 change;the exact original AA runtime patch is not independently recovered.
TT: Explicit AA differences says greatly increased cast point,but no reliable numerical custom point has been recovered. Current public0.3 equals native and remains a known unresolved custom-timing gap,not native-complete acceptance.
Mixed accuracy/blind/evasion PRD trial ordering and correlation use declared engine working order;wearer PRD evidence does not prove the whole native stream ordering.
Specific Smoke-during-Tricks/channel-queue continuation and mid-windup Sleight overlap are not fully modeled/native-certified. Official AA Season4 start gate is covered separately.
Fog-of-war targeting,player shift queues and hold/stop options are outside the planar automated input model. No missing Cloak/backstab skill or full ally-jump Scepter is silently granted.
MU: Recovery uses explicit AA1.5second action suppression plus native2BAT marker. Foreign IAS/BAT/time-factor interactions and ranged pulse versus in-flight attack order are not all source/result-closed.
AA StrongOnly category conflicts with historical death-only modifier. Wiki nonnumeric mechanism is chosen;no original AA Lua confirms a deliberate custom dispel override.
AA/wiki print base-attack-speed slow as60/80/100 without percent while raw key name contains pct. Current flat attack-speed-point choice preserves displayed values;exact AA formula remains unproven.
Unlimited AS opt-in bypasses old0.12floor,but30Hz quantization/FIXED_STEP remains. This is not native certification of arbitrary greater-than30attacks/second.
WR: AA grants two charges but does not state quarter-second reuse or complete old7.22Scepter movement behavior. Public final recharge is authoritative;quarter-second reuse is a transparent historical-prototype compatibility choice.
Shared stolen-charge acquisition/transfer/refresh/reacquire behavior has finite engineering regressions elsewhere,not comprehensive native source closure for every body/slot transition.
